verdict.rationale: Omarchy is installed via a standard ISO to any hardware, explicitly supports NVIDIA GPUs and other drivers during installation, and offers dual-boot/unattended install options alongside Windows — all indicating it isn't locked to specific vendor hardware. Community reports confirm real-world installs on varied setups (e.g., dual-booting a work laptop, testing on Manjaro), reinforcing hardware flexibility. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of broader hardware compatibility (e.g., AMD/Intel GPUs, laptops, ARM), and no first-party statement addressing 'vendor lock-in' beyond being Arch-based.
